decisions.what_changed: One form for part and skill names everywhere: Title Case, the DESIGN section 3 names, with plain display names for the two research names. A new display-name layer, web/src/axis-names.ts (AXIS_NAMES, axisName(code), PLAIN_AXIS_NAMES), gives every screen its skill names: LG 'Logic Games', CAL 'Confidence Calibration', every other axis its registry name (already Title Case; EMO keeps its R-5.6.2 name word for word, '(text scenarios)' included). The engine registry (web/src/engine/axes.ts) and its bank twin (src/hb/axes.py) are unchanged: they keep the section 3 names as the shared axis spec, so nothing in the bank, the golden files or the save format moves. Session: segments.ts now derives each part's title from axisName of its axis (so 'Reaction time' became 'Reaction Time': the interstitial 'Up next: Reaction Time', the part h1 and page title 'Reaction Time · HumanBench', the ready screen's resume line, the focus picker), and skipTargetName (checklist, 'Skip Reaction Time', the skipped/unavailable notices, the Finished list) returns axisName. Results: viz/profile.ts axisEstimates names (bar table rows, blob, peaks list, 'Not measured: ...' list, reveal 'now drawing' line, share card toggles), viz/card.ts (card skill names, peaks, alt text), viz/facets.ts (a facet's group), reveal/peaks.ts and reveal/norms.ts (pace lines) all take axisName. Chart labels: CAL's two-line label is the whole display name ('Confidence' / 'Calibration'); the one-line phone labels are Title Case cuts ('Logic Games', 'Reading Comp.', 'Working Mem.', 'Arts & Practical'), and CAL's stays 'Calibration'. The served privacy notice names the parts in Title Case. web/HOUSE-STYLE.md has a fixed point for names. e2e drivers and specs, DOM tests and scripts/e2e-parts.test.ts now match 'Reaction Time'.

web/e2e/routes.ts, outside the rename: toInterstitial now declines the break offer that the D5 run package moved to the boundary before Working Memory (it appears when a route skips into that part), and the 'break-offer' and 'on-break' routes reach the offer by skipping Reaction Time, Matrix & Series and Spatial instead of fast-forwarding 31 minutes (the 30-active-minute rule is gone). Without it 7 a11y routes (memory-intro, memory-entry, quant-item, coding-intro, coding-running, break-offer, on-break) failed all their a11y.spec.ts tests on 'Time for a break?' (42 failures in shard 1/3); with it the 49 tests of those routes pass.

web/e2e/session.spec.ts, outside the rename: 'the under-18 path writes nothing' expected no button on the under-18 screen; the funnel package's D24 put 'I chose this by mistake' there, so it now expects that one button (it goes back to the gate, not further). Passes on Chromium.
deviations: Display-name layer instead of new engine names: the registry names are the shared axis spec with bank hb.axes and the DESIGN section 3 names (engine/axes.test.ts 'matches the shared axis spec row by row', bank tests/test_axes.py), so they stay; only the pub UI shows the display names. The bank is untouched.

CAL's one-line phone label stays 'Calibration' (a cut of 'Confidence Calibration', the thing measured), not 'Confidence' as COPY-19 suggested (ux-review/findings/copy.json): 'Confidence' alone reads as how confident the person is, and a higher estimate does not mean that.

The renderers' block titles ('One position', 'Four positions', 'Digits, same order', 'Block sequence', 'Shape to digit', 'Reading') are left in sentence case: they name a block inside a part, not a part or a skill, and ux-render.spec.ts pins that they differ from the part's h1.
Drill-down facet labels ('Simple reaction time', 'Choice reaction time', 'Odd one out', ...) are left in sentence case: they are sub-facets, not part or skill names.
Running text that speaks of a measure in general stays lower case ('your typical simple reaction time', 'reaction times use the time stamp ...'); HOUSE-STYLE.md says so.

e2e/routes.ts also got a fix that has nothing to do with names (toInterstitial and the two break routes, see tests): the D5 run package changed when the break is offered but left these a11y drivers as they were, and they are the drivers this package had to edit for the titles anyway.
open_issues: Facet labels and block titles are sentence case while part and skill names are Title Case (see deviations); if the owner wants every label in one case, that is a further change of viz/facets.ts FACET_LABELS and the renderer titles.

Worked-example titles on the results page are 'Example n: Matrix', 'Sequence', 'Quantitative' (question kinds, not part names); 'Quantitative' could become 'Quantitative Reasoning' if the owner reads them as part names.

The Title Case phone labels are a little wider than before ('Reading Comp.', 'Working Mem.', 'Arts & Practical', 'Logic Games'). Re-measured at 320 px for the every-skill profile (e2e/uxdec-viz.spec.ts D14 log): main chart 11.00 px with the system font and 10.77 px with the wide font (10.94 px before this package), Knowledge facets 10.70 px; the 10 px floor of e2e/blob.spec.ts holds with less margin than before.

requests.change: Integrate (or the run package): 9 Chromium tests fail on the run package's D5, not on names, and need rewriting to the new break and clock rules. (1) 'a break is suggested at 30 minutes at the next boundary', (2) 'the suggestion is made once', (3) 'the offer waits for the end of the item on screen': they fast-forward 30 minutes and expect 'Time for a break?' after the first skip; the offer now comes only before the half-way part (Working Memory), whatever the time, and never mid-part, so (3)'s premise is gone and (1)/(2) should reach it by skipping RT, MAT and SPA (ux-session.spec.ts already covers the new rule). (4) 'QR keeps its coverage floor of 3 items when the time budget is gone', (5) 'a start that was abandoned before any answer ...': quantWithoutBudget expects 'Up next: Working Memory' after skipping Spatial and gets the break offer; it must decline it ('Keep going'), and its 28-minute jump on the QR interstitial no longer uses the budget (the clock is held on interstitials), so the 'time budget is gone' premise needs a jump inside a part. (6) 'the ring follows session time' and (8) 'the ?fast=1 dev flag ... the timeline runs faster': they fast-forward on an interstitial and expect the ring to move; it is held there now ('The clock waits until you press Start'), so they must Start a part first. (7) session.spec.ts:736 'without WebGL the Spatial item offers the skip' and (9) ux2-session.spec.ts:398 'Skip leaves for the next part': after skipping Spatial the break offer comes before 'Up next: Working Memory'; decline it or expect it. The funnel package's handoff already reported (9).
requests.why: Not part of D25; they encode D5's rules, which the run package owns. Left unchanged here.
